correctness.rationale: At a geometric boundary point the multiplicity is the product of the factorials of the balanced nonzero sign classes and the perfect-matching count on the zero indices. This gives precisely 1,2,3,6. A twisted-rational point in a plane intersection lies in its Frobenius saturation. In odd characteristic, each bipartite connected component then contributes one scalar, every other component contributes none; the stable linear subspace descends, so its point polynomial is 1+q+…+q^(b−1), including 0 when b=0. Binomial inversion on subsets of the incidence set is valid. Independently reproduced all 44 entries by an alternative stratification: fifteen multiplicity-three points (support size 2), ten multiplicity-six points (balanced full support), and forty-five multiplicity-two lines with three exceptional points removed (the size-two support point and the two full-support nodes). Exact multiplicity two singles out its line, and exact multiplicity one singles out its plane, so count fixed punctured lines, then subtract higher multiplicity incidences from fixed-plane totals. Replay `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_reproduce.py` (section 3). A 5-cycle has three matching orbits of length five and cannot preserve a nonempty incidence set of any allowed size. The split boundary sum 15q²−30q+25 at extensions of degree 5k gives exponents 3,−6,5 in the reciprocal zeta factors at T^5 exactly as printed. Inverting the Frobenius convention does not change the permutation class or the extensions used.
residual_risks: The calculation is for the marked coordinate-permutation forms and their boundary, not all points of the ambient cubic or characteristic two.

value.rationale: The arithmetic object is the canonical plane boundary of a classical threefold, not an arbitrary subset. The table is complete in twist type and geometric multiplicity and lets a researcher count rational points on each stratum over every extension. The fifth-degree obstruction distinguishes a nonempty boundary with no low-degree points from ordinary split forms and is invisible to a census of the ambient threefold alone.
residual_risks: Value is the refined boundary invariant; neither the classical plane configuration nor the classification of forms is a new consequence claimed here.
